title: Webhook Configuration
description: Shared capability configuration schemas for subscribing to and advertising capability event webhooks.

platform_config.title: Platform Webhook Config
platform_config.description: Platform webhook subscription configuration declared under a capability's `config.webhook` in a platform profile.

url.description: HTTPS URL where the Business delivers signed webhook notifications for this capability.

events.description: Event types the Platform subscribes to for this capability. When omitted, the Platform subscribes to all event types the Business emits for this capability.

business_config.title: Business Webhook Config
business_config.description: Business webhook advertisement in a discovery profile and subscription confirmation in capability response entries.

events.description: In a Business discovery profile, the event types the Business emits for this capability. In a capability response entry (`ucp.capabilities`), the intersected event types confirmed for the active subscription.
